title: Single Leg Squat
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Ask the patient to stand on one leg, with the other foot clear of the ground and the arms free.
Ask them to squat as far as they comfortably can and return, watching from the front and then from the side.
Compare both sides, since the test is interpreted by comparison.
